hooks.text: 核心攻击不是射击，而是高速冲撞、贯穿和喷射组成的异形碰撞战斗。
hooks.excerpt: A special roguelike game that focuses entirely on ramming, piercing, and spraying as the core gameplay.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 持续移动会产能，也能从敌舰偷能量，蓄足后变成无敌水滴直接刺穿舰体。
hooks.excerpt: Just by being in motion you can generate a constant stream of energy, and mysterious alien technology also allows Gotrop to steal energy directly from his enemies. There is energy can be transformed into an invincible droplet state, invulnerable and unbreakable, our enemies can not cause any damage to us, but we can directly puncture the inside of their battleships havoc!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 清理战场就能拾取变形科技，在钻头、反弹装甲和喷弹口之间改变机体能力。
hooks.excerpt: Whether it's a drill that can drill into enemy ships faster, outer armor that can reflect all attacks, or a spout that spews bullets, they can be acquired after sweeping through the enemy!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
